versions.changelog:
## Villager Birthday Reminders 1.0

First release.

- A short letter arrives in the mailbox on the morning of a villager's birthday, every year.
- Each letter names one gift that villager loves: 33 villagers of Pelican Town and the valley.
- Letters only come for villagers you have already met.

## Villager Birthday Reminders 1.1

A reminder the day before.

- New: a short letter the morning before each birthday ("Tomorrow is …'s birthday!"), with the same gift idea, so there is a day to get the gift ready.
- On by default. Don't want it? Switch off "DayBefore" in the config (config.json or the in-game config menu); the letter on the birthday itself always comes.
- A birthday on the 1st gets its reminder on the 28th of the season before (Krobus: fall 28).
- As before, letters only come for villagers you have already met.

## Villager Birthday Reminders 1.2

Island villagers.

- New: Leo from Ginger Island gets his letters too: on his birthday (summer 26) and, if "DayBefore" is on, the morning before (summer 25). Gift idea: a Mango, one of his loved gifts.
- His letters only come once you have met him on the island, so nothing is spoiled before you get there.
- Leo is the only island villager with a birthday. That makes 34 villagers in all.
- The 33 villagers of 1.1 and the reminder the day before are unchanged.

## Villager Birthday Reminders 1.3

Now in German too.

- All birthday letters and reminders for the day before, with their titles, are translated into German: 68 letters for all 34 villagers, including Leo. Players with the game set to German get the German letters; everyone else keeps the English ones.
- Each gift idea uses the item's German name from the game, and the Wizard and the Dwarf are "der Zauberer" and "der Zwerg".
- Same gift ideas, same dates, same "DayBefore" switch; nothing else changes.
